*Previously announced follow-on orders from an existing governmental intelligence customer reflect continued operational use of Maris-Tech’s edge video and AI technology in mission-critical, bandwidth-constrained environments*


Rehovot, Israel, Sept. 14, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global provider of video and artificial intelligence (“AI”)-based edge computing technology, today provided an update highlighting a series of previously announced orders from an existing governmental customer operating in the intelligence gathering domain, including follow-on orders announced in June 2026 and an additional follow-on order announced in August 2026.


The June orders extended the ongoing deployment of Maris-Tech’s edge video and AI systems and reflected continued operational use in mission-critical environments. The August order continued a series of product deployments with the same customer, which is already operating Maris-Tech systems in the field for intelligence gathering applications, and followed earlier orders announced in March, April and June 2026.


Taken together, the orders reinforce the customer’s sustained use of the Company’s solutions for real-time video capture, processing and transmission directly at the point of collection, including in bandwidth-constrained conditions.


Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech, said: “The repeat orders we have received from a customer already operating our systems in the field are the clearest signal we can ask for. An additional order from that same customer provides meaningful validation of both the technology and our ability to support its operational requirements. We believe these previously announced orders demonstrate how our solutions perform when they matter.”


Maris-Tech continues to support intelligence and defense-related applications with edge-based video and AI technologies designed for deployment in complex operational conditions.


**About Maris-Tech Ltd.**


Maris-Tech is a global leader in video and AI-based edge computing technology, pioneering intelligent video transmission solutions that conquer complex encoding-decoding challenges. The Company’s miniature, lightweight, and low-power products deliver high-performance capabilities, including raw data processing, seamless transfer, advanced image processing, and AI-driven analytics. Founded by Israeli technology sector veterans, Maris-Tech serves leading manufacturers worldwide in defense, aerospace, intelligence gathering, homeland security, and communication industries. We’re pushing the boundaries of video transmission and edge computing, driving innovation in mission-critical applications across commercial and defense sectors.
